summary: End-to-end AI sales workspace: finds prospects, tells you how to warm them up, and writes the offer and deck from your docs. Free plan with no credit card.
description: End-to-end AI sales workspace: finds prospects, tells you how to warm them up, and writes the offer and deck from your docs. Free plan with no credit card.

pricing.details: Official prices excluding VAT (VAT at checkout). Free 0 €, no time limit, no card — one-time AI credits, 1 seat, Knowledge Hub OCR up to 100 pages. Starter regular 44 €/month + VAT; official 3-month −15% promo: 38 €/month + VAT — 1 seat, 5× the Free plan’s AI credits each month, OCR up to 1,000 pages/month. Pro regular 180 €/month + VAT; official 3-month −15% promo: 153 €/month + VAT — up to 3 seats, 20× Free credits, long-term memory, agent learning, OCR up to 10,000 pages/month. Custom plans priced to the team.
pricing.label: Freemium
